rule: Only genuine bug fixes after the freeze; each is recorded here with its reason.

change_log.reason: Initial freeze for the core release candidate, after the hardening tests (includes the agent-failure fix: an agent's execution error is now reported in the assessment's open questions)

bug fix: Technical Agent issued latency and PDU-session queries for symptoms nobody reported, so an irrelevant chunk got unrelated 3GPP clauses quoted; symptom queries now fire only for released symptoms, and with no technical symptom the agent retrieves nothing (found by the evidence audit's irrelevant-retrieval test)

fix: in-force status and amendments established by obtained documents (commencement notifications, amendment rules) were not carried to evidence or named by the Verifier; EvidenceItem gains effective_status (additive) and the INCOMPLETE rationale now names the recorded status and amendment. Outcomes unchanged: amendment_checked stays false, so nothing on real sources is VERIFIED.

feature (requested by the team for the build-a-thon brief, not a bug fix): additive hooks only — ScenarioChunk.agent_views (each agent receives its own information) and AgentFinding.reasoning_trace with defaults (models.py); the Orchestrator passes each agent its view and records it (orchestrator.py); BaseAgent calls the optional LLM step src/llm/synthesis.enrich, a no-op when offline (base_agent.py); agent views added to both scenarios; region-labelled comparators and an accurate neighbouring-country note (policy_gap_agent.py). Agent selection, incident flags and the DOCX stage tables are unchanged; an agent's own view facts can enter its retrieval queries, so live-KB evidence may differ from runs recorded before; with no LLM configured no model is called; all tests pass.
